name: Joseph And Mary
overview: The Scriptures reveal the divine orchestration surrounding Joseph and Mary in the birth of Jesus Christ. Isaiah foretold a virgin would conceive and bear a son named Immanuel, a sign fulfilled when Mary, espoused to Joseph, was found to be with child by the Holy Spirit. Joseph, initially troubled, was reassured by angelic dreams to accept Mary as his wife and protect the child, obeying God's guidance to flee to Egypt to preserve Jesus' life from Herod's threat.
